description: You are the Chief Financial Officer at a healthcare IT company. Your finance team has flagged that the total value of active opportunities in SuiteCRM (all stages except Closed Won and Closed Lost) is significantly inflated compared to the validated quarterly forecast. The audited forecast for active deals should total approximately $19.74 million, but the system currently reports over $35 million. Investigate the entire opportunity pipeline, identify all duplicate entries and any deals with artificially inflated amounts, and correct every discrepancy you find. Exercise caution: not every similarly-named deal is a duplicate, and some recently-added opportunities are legitimate new business. Do not remove or alter valid opportunities.
